import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    
    static class Mod {
        int val;
        
        Mod(long v) {
            v %= MOD;
            if (v < 0) v += MOD;
            val = (int)v;
        }
        
        Mod(int v) {
            val = v % MOD;
            if (val < 0) val += MOD;
        }
        
        Mod() {
            val = 0;
        }
        
        static int modInverse(int a, int m) {
            int g = m, r = a, x = 0, y = 1;
            while (r != 0) {
                int q = g / r;
                g %= r;
                int temp = g;
                g = r;
                r = temp;
                x -= q * y;
                temp = x;
                x = y;
                y = temp;
            }
            if (x < 0) x += m;
            return x;
        }
        
        static int modInverse(int a) {
            return modInverse(a, MOD);
        }
        
        Mod add(Mod other) {
            val += other.val;
            if (val >= MOD) val -= MOD;
            return this;
        }
        
        Mod sub(Mod other) {
            val -= other.val;
            if (val < 0) val += MOD;
            return this;
        }
        
        static long fastMod(long x) {
            return x % MOD;
        }
        
        Mod mul(Mod other) {
            val = (int)fastMod((long)val * other.val);
            return this;
        }
        
        Mod div(Mod other) {
            return mul(other.modInverse());
        }
        
        Mod addSelf(Mod other) {
            val += other.val;
            if (val >= MOD) val -= MOD;
            return this;
        }
        
        Mod subSelf(Mod other) {
            val -= other.val;
            if (val < 0) val += MOD;
            return this;
        }
        
        Mod mulSelf(Mod other) {
            val = (int)fastMod((long)val * other.val);
            return this;
        }
        
        Mod divSelf(Mod other) {
            return mulSelf(other.modInverse());
        }
        
        Mod increment() {
            val = (val == MOD - 1) ? 0 : val + 1;
            return this;
        }
        
        Mod decrement() {
            val = (val == 0) ? MOD - 1 : val - 1;
            return this;
        }
        
        Mod negate() {
            return val == 0 ? new Mod(0) : new Mod(MOD - val);
        }
        
        boolean equals(Mod other) {
            return val == other.val;
        }
        
        Mod modInverse() {
            return new Mod(modInverse(val));
        }
        
        Mod power(long exp) {
            Mod base = new Mod(val);
            Mod res = new Mod(1);
            while (exp > 0) {
                if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                    res.mulSelf(base);
                }
                base.mulSelf(base);
                exp >>= 1;
            }
            return res;
        }
    }
    
    static final int MAX_N = 7;
    static int N;
    static Mod[][] P = new Mod[MAX_N][MAX_N];
    
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        N = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                int p = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
                P[i][j] = new Mod(p).div(new Mod(100));
            }
        }
        
        List<List<Integer>> masksByPop = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i <= MAX_N; ++i) {
            masksByPop.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }
        
        int[] idx = new int[1 << N];
        Arrays.fill(idx, -1);
        
        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << N); ++mask) {
            int pop = Integer.bitCount(mask);
            idx[mask] = masksByPop.get(pop).size();
            masksByPop.get(pop).add(mask);
        }
        
        Map<Long, Mod> dp = new HashMap<>();
        dp.put(1L << idx[0], new Mod(1));
        
        for (int step = 0; step < N; ++step) {
            Map<Long, Mod> newDp = new HashMap<>();
            
            for (int cur = 0; cur < (1 << N); ++cur) {
                Mod prod = new Mod(1);
                for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                    if (((cur >> j) & 1) == 1) {
                        prod.mulSelf(P[step][j]);
                    } else {
                        Mod one = new Mod(1);
                        Mod p = P[step][j];
                        Mod diff = new Mod(one.val - p.val + MOD);
                        prod.mulSelf(diff);
                    }
                }
                
                for (Map.Entry<Long, Mod> entry : dp.entrySet()) {
                    long state = entry.getKey();
                    Mod prob = entry.getValue();
                    
                    long nextState = 0;
                    
                    for (int mask : masksByPop.get(step)) {
                        if (((state >> idx[mask]) & 1) == 1) {
                            for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
                                if ((((cur >> i) & 1) == 1) && (((mask >> i) & 1) == 0)) {
                                    nextState |= 1L << idx[mask | (1 << i)];
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    
                    Mod newProb = new Mod(prob.val);
                    newProb.mulSelf(prod);
                    
                    newDp.put(nextState, newDp.getOrDefault(nextState, new Mod(0)).addSelf(newProb));
                }
            }
            
            dp = newDp;
        }
        
        Mod answer = new Mod(0);
        long full = (1L << N) - 1;
        
        for (Map.Entry<Long, Mod> entry : dp.entrySet()) {
            if (((entry.getKey() >> idx[(int)full]) & 1) == 1) {
                answer.addSelf(entry.getValue());
            }
        }
        
        System.out.println(answer.val);
    }
}
